cd /workspace/tmp && python3 -c "
import subprocess,resource,time,json,sys,os
t0=time.time()
with open('/workspace/tmp/batch2.json','rb') as f, open('/workspace/tmp/out2.json','wb') as o:
    p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B','/workspace/submission/main.py'],stdin=f,stdout=o,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,cwd='/workspace/tmp',env={'PATH':'/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin','NETNOMOS_DEPS':'/workspace/vendor','PYTHONHASHSEED':'0','LANG':'C','TMPDIR':'/workspace/tmp'})

print('maxrss MB', resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN).ru_maxrss/1024)
d=json.load(open('/workspace/tmp/out2.json'))
